rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Walked every pronoun/demonstrative in reading order. Chunk 3 line 60 "after that" resolves within-chunk to "first 3LO consent" (line 60); chunk 4 line 77 "the three trackers" resolves to GitHub/Jira/Linear, all named in earlier chunks of this same file (arc-earned, not cross-file); chunk 6 line 91 "this way" resolves to the marketplace-install sentence immediately above it in the same chunk. No never-named, vague, or re-chunk-stranded referent found.

No chunk points at another file by position; all references are within-file (rule 1's arc-earned vocabulary) or named external sources with link text (e.g. line 19 "Sources:" list). No "the opening lecture said" or module-relative phrasing present.

rules_evaluated.evidence: Smallest chunk (index 5, "Other trackers", lines 83-87, 31 words per check-slide-size.js) still carries a self-standing claim: "Check the Anthropic Directory for reviewed connectors and your tracker's own docs. Most have a third-party MCP or a CLI fallback (like gh)." Every other chunk carries substantially more. No wait-state or context-dependent single bullet found.

Checked each header against its chunk's content under cover-the-body/uncover test: "Three paths to a work-app action" -> body lists exactly three numbered paths (lines 11-13); "What Claude Code doesn't do yet (as of 2026-08-19)" -> body is a gaps list (lines 116-120); "Marketplace governance: official vs team, and when to reach for plugin distribution" -> body covers both halves (lines 106, 110). No header contradicted by its own chunk.

No "Not X. Not Y. Z." construction, no anaphora/epistrophe triple, no number-plus-retraction, no abstraction-noun stack, no empty-leg verb triplet found in any chunk. Line 77 "Cleanest UX of the three trackers for solo engineers" is a comparative claim about the external product (Linear), not a self-grading superlative about this training's own material, so it does not trip the value-prop-leak sub-item.
